description: This file declares functions related to batched linear algebra operations using CUDA in the PyTorch framework, including LU, Cholesky, SVD, and eigenvalue computations, with specific configurations for cuSOLVER versions and CUDA compatibility.

methods.name: geqrf_batched_cublas
methods.description: Performs QR factorization on a batch of matrices using cuBLAS.

methods.name: triangular_solve_batched_cublas
methods.description: Performs batched triangular solves with cuBLAS.

methods.name: gels_batched_cublas
methods.description: Performs batched least squares problem solving with cuBLAS.

methods.name: ldl_solve_cusolver
methods.description: Solves LDL factored systems using cuSOLVER.

methods.name: lu_factor_batched_cublas
methods.description: Performs batched LU factorization using cuBLAS.

methods.name: lu_solve_batched_cublas
methods.description: Solves LU factored systems in batch using cuBLAS.

methods.name: svd_cusolver
methods.description: Computes the singular value decomposition using cuSOLVER.

methods.name: _cholesky_solve_helper_cuda_cusolver
methods.description: Helper function for solving systems with Cholesky decomposed matrices.

methods.name: cholesky_inverse_kernel_impl_cusolver
methods.description: Computes inverse of a matrix from its Cholesky factorization.

methods.name: ormqr_cusolver
methods.description: Applies orthogonal Q to a matrix using cuSOLVER.

methods.name: orgqr_helper_cusolver
methods.description: Computes Q matrix from QR factorization.

methods.name: linalg_eigh_cusolver
methods.description: Calculates eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a Hermitian matrix using cuSOLVER.

methods.name: linalg_eig_cusolver_xgeev
methods.description: Calculates eigenvalues and eigenvectors for a general matrix using cuSOLVER, conditionally compiled based on version.

methods.name: lu_solve_looped_cusolver
methods.description: Solves multiple LU decompositions in a loop using cuSOLVER.

methods.name: lu_factor_looped_cusolver
methods.description: Performs batched LU factorization in a loop using cuSOLVER.
